name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
September 14, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PROCLAMATION FOR NATIONAL RECOVERY MONTH - It is recommended the City Council proclaim September 2021 as National Recovery Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Desiree Johnson.
5.1 Proclamation for National Recovery Month
5.2
RECOGNITION OF ELAINE WILLIAMS FOR HER DEDICATED SERVICE TO THE COMMUNITY - It is recommended the City Council present Elaine Williams with a plaque in recognition of her service to the La Mirada community.
5.2 Recognition of Elaine Williams
5.3
RECOGNITION OF LA MIRADA LITTLE LEAGUE All STARS 2021 JUNIOR DIVISION TEAM - It is recommended the City Council recognize the athletes and coaches of the La Mirada Little League All Stars Junior Division Team and present them with Certificates of Recognition.
5.3 Recognition of La Mirada Little League All Stars
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of August 24, 2021.
7.1 Minutes of August 24, 2021
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated September 14, 2021 in the total amount of $1,558,630.06.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING JULY 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending July 2021.
7.3 Monthly Treasurer Report
7.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-03 CITY HALL CARPET REPLACEMENT - APPROVAL OF CHANGE ORDERS AND ADDITIONAL SERVICES WITH COMMERCIAL INTERIOR RESOURCES - It is recommended the City Council approve the revised contract amount of $133,861.76 and authorize the City Manager to execute Change Order Nos. 3 and 4 in the amount up to $39,194.76.
7.4 CIP No. 2021-03
7.5
APPROVAL OF A FACILITY USE AGREEMENT WITH BIOLA UNIVERSITY FOR USE OF THE 50-METER POOL AT SPLASH! LA MIRADA REGIONAL AQUATICS CENTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the request from Biola University for use of the 50-meter competition pool at Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center and authorize the City Manager to execute a Facility Use Agreement with Biola University for its 2021-2022 water polo season.
7.5 Facility Use Agreement with Biola University
7.6
APPROVAL OF FACILITY USE FOR THE KIWANIS CLUB OF LA MIRADA FUNDRAISING EVENT - It is recommended the City Council approve the request for use of Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center for the Kiwanis Club of La Mirada fundraiser event and waive all rental fees with the associated use.
7.6 Facility Use Agreement with Kiwanis
7.7
IMPERIAL HIGHWAY COMPLETE STREET STUDY AGREEMENT - It is recommended the City Council approve the Imperial Highway Complete Street Study Implementation Agreement with the Gateway Cities Council of Governments.
7.7 Imperial Hwy Complete Street Study Agreement
8.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
8.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 718 SETTING CALIFORNIA PRIMARY ELECTION DATES AS THE CITY COUNCIL ELECTION DATES AS REQUIRED BY LAW - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 718 setting California Primary Election dates as the City Council Election dates as required by law, by title only, and waive further reading.
8.1 Ordinance No. 718 - 2nd Reading
